text:
leo: heads up: intermittent failures in samplekit when using json-mode + fncall. Validator says 'expected object, got null'. JS SDK v1.4.3, Py v1.4.0.
anya: Is this on normal traffic or only when tokens refresh?
leo: Pretty sure after auth retry. Repro steps attached to the sampleapp issue.
pranav: Can you paste the function schema and the exact model outputs?
leo: minimal:
```json
"function": {"name":"upsert","parameters": {"type":"object","properties":{"metadata":{"type":"object","nullable":true}}}}

observed outputs:
{"metadata": null}
// sometimes
{"metadata": {}}
```
anya: That's odd. SDK should treat explicit null from model as null and {} as an object. If retry wrapper reserializes args it can flip types.
pranav: Suspect double-serialize in retry path -> json-mode parser runs twice -> sanitizer sees string 'null' vs parsed {}.
qa-bot: test: added flaky test to CI that simulates token refresh with both payload shapes.
runtime-bot: FYI: we deployed a tight-canary fix to auth-retry handling at 2026-02-22 09:12 UTC.
leo: Short-term workaround in sampleapp: normalize after parse:
```js
if (resp.metadata === null && schema.metadata?.type === 'object') resp.metadata = {}
```
pranav: Longer term: fix retry double-encode in runtime + add cross-SDK sanitizer parity tests. Also consider SDK sanitizer rule: never coerce {} -> null.
anya: I'll add a docs note in starter-kit about JSON mode caveats.
leo: Filed issue #3498 and linked repro. Assigning to eng-runtime + devex. Thanks all. :rocket:
